sentences.text:
Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
 Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order
S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures D/56 Extension OF Interim Bail Application (IA) No.2 of 2025  In  BA1 No.485 of 2025
Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Deputy Advocate General for the State.
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the informant.

The applicant was granted interim bail in FIR No. 485 of 2024, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 471 and 120-B IPC, Police Station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar on 17.06.2025 because it was then argued that the main accused has been granted short term bail for two months so as to settle the dispute with the respondent Bank.
The interim bail granted to the applicant was extended last time on 13.08.2025.
Now, Application for Extension of Interim Bail (IA) No.2 of 2025 has been filed for extension of interim bail for further two months.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the short term bail of the co-accused has further been extended till 06.10.2025, so as to settle the matter with the informant Bank.
Learned counsel for the informant Bank submits that the applicant should also participate in the settlement process.
Having considered, without adverting to the merits, purely on humanitarian ground, the Court is of the view that the time extension application deserves to be allowed.
The time extension application is allowed.
Interim bail granted to the applicant is extended till 06.10.2025 from the date of its expiry.

It is further directed that, on expiry of the duration of extended period, the applicant shall surrender before the court concerned and intimation to that effect shall also be given to this Court.
List on 10.10.2025.
BA1/485/2025 on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126053155/
1 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 04.09.2025
